sqlMap.select: SELECT t.OPT_CODE AS code, t.OPT_NAME AS name, t.OPT_TYPE AS type, t.PARENT_OPT_CODE parentCode, t.OPT_VALUE value, t.OPT_VALUE_SHOW_TYPE showType, t.SHOW_INDEX showIndex, t.OPT_SELECT_VALUES selectValues, t.REMARK FROM ssm_option t order by t.OPT_CODE
SELECT t.OPT_CODE AS code, t.OPT_NAME AS name, t.OPT_VALUE value FROM ssm_option t
sqlMap.update: update ssm_option set OPT_VALUE = '$value$' where OPT_CODE = #code#
